title: Azure Functions DX Toolkit — endpoint metadata namespace (v1 scenario)
description: Shape of _azure_functions_metadata["endpoint"]. Producer packages (e.g. azure-functions-validation, azure-functions-langgraph) write this payload; consumer packages (e.g. azure-functions-openapi) read it. This schema is an internal conformance artifact of azure-functions-validation used by its own tests; it is not published, dereferenced, or shared as a runtime contract. Each package owns its local conformance tests against the versioned dict convention.

version.description: Schema version for the endpoint namespace payload. Consumers MUST warn (not fail) on an unknown version and fall back gracefully.

request_body.description: JSON Schema of the request body model, or null when the endpoint takes no body. Canonicalization: Pydantic model_json_schema(by_alias=True, mode='validation', ref_template='#/$defs/{model}'). $defs are left UNRESOLVED — the consumer (openapi) hoists them into components/schemas and remains the sole $ref-collision authority.

request_body_required.description: Whether the request body is required. Defaults to true unless every field of the body model has a default.

parameters.description: OpenAPI-style parameter objects derived from query/path/header models. Refs, if present, MUST remain unresolved and be accompanied by $defs on the owning schema.

responses.description: Map of HTTP status code (as string) to a response object carrying the response's JSON Schema; null when the producer has no responses to describe. Pydantic-derived response-model schemas use mode='serialization'; other entries (e.g. the 422 validation-error schema) are produced directly and are unaffected.

summary.description: Short human-readable summary of the operation.

description.description: Longer human-readable description of the operation.

security.description: OpenAPI security requirement objects for the operation.

jsonSchema.description: An embedded JSON Schema document (Pydantic-generated). Kept permissive: producers embed schemas verbatim; the consumer validates structure.

response.description: OpenAPI-style response object carrying an embedded response schema.
